text:
Maya (Product): dropping a quick thread on the compact billing row + invoice mapping. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-invoice -> goal: make rows dense but keep token->cost mapping exportable.
Rae (Design): mocked a dense row with a small 'breakdown' pill and an inline summary. Desktop shows the pill; mobile collapses it behind a chevron.
Sam (PM): growth wants numbers visible without extra clicks on desktop. can we show a 2-value inline summary (top buckets) and hide the rest?
Leo (Eng): perf callout: rendering many small DOM pills across hundreds of rows causes paint spikes. prefer rendering a single SVG/text chunk per row or a single span with compact text.
Anya (A11y): avoid hover-only reveals. keyboard focus must surface the same info. screen readers need an aria-summary for the row with explicit labels (Prompt, Completion, Cached).
Maya (Product): proposal: Desktop = inline compact text like "4.2k | 1.1k | 200"; Mobile = "5.5k tokens" + expand; Keyboard = focus reveals same inline text. copy tweak: change "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Projected monthly cost" across billing surfaces.
John (Revenue): CSV/export constraint: whatever we show must map deterministically to columns. customers expect headers like transaction_id,account_id,project_id,token_bucket,tokens,cost_usd,date. If we aggregate on UI, ensure mapping back to raw buckets is preserved in export.
Rae (Design): alternative: show top-2 buckets inline and an overflow "+n" that opens a detail panel. keeps rows clean.
Sam (PM): top-2 + overflow might be best tradeoff for conversion + density.
Leo (Eng): overflow detail can be lazy-loaded. backend should send a compact aggregated payload to avoid extra requests per row. also we'll precompute 7-day sparkline points.
Anya (A11y): tooltip/overflow must be keyboard-openable and use role="dialog" or role="tooltip" as appropriate. ensure full breakdown text is included for assistive tech (no visual-only cues).
Maya (Product): accessibility + perf are both constraints. action items: Rae to update mocks with top-2 + overflow variant; Eng to confirm payload shape and perf cost; Revenue to review CSV schema draft; I'll update copy to "Projected monthly cost".
Preview-bot: preview build #612 deployed to preview branch: https://preview.redwood/branch/compact-invoice-612
Leo (Eng): initial perf note: single-span text is cheapest; single SVG per row is okay too. will run sweep on mid/low-end devices after updated mocks.
John (Revenue): I'll draft CSV header suggestion and include an example row mapping. will post it here when ready.
Rae (Design): uploading updated mocks and a condensed mobile flow by EOD. annotating color tokens for contrast checks.
Anya (A11y): contrast nit: some small inline text in dark mode is ~3.7:1. needs 4.5:1 for small text. recommend bold or lighter chip bg.
Maya (Product): decision summary for now: desktop = top-2 inline + "+n" overflow; mobile = condensed summary + tap expand; keyboard = focus reveals overflow; UI uses "Projected monthly cost" label; CSV to keep raw bucket mapping. I'll consolidate into the spec and post a short Loom after perf pass. :white_check_mark:
